correctness.rationale: A nonlandmark a_i is distinguished from another nonlandmark a_j only by whether its mate b_i is a landmark, forcing <=2 omitted a and similarly <=2 omitted b. Six omissions then require both spine endpoints omitted and equal a,b landmark counts, making their distance multisets coincide. The explicit five-omission witness has five distinct m_1,m_2,m_3 signatures for each r>=3. Exhausting size-five cases forces two listed types; their signatures are distinct except the type-two r=3 collision. Combinatorial multiplicities give 12 and 2r(r−1)^2. Independently enumerated ALL vertex subsets for r=3,4,5,6 using BFS distances: max five omissions and counts 12,72,160,300. Finite checks corroborate structural proof.

final_claim: For square-page book graph B_r of r >=3 four-cycles sharing a spine edge, outer multiset dimension is 2r−3=|V|−5; all minimum landmark complements are either both spine+full page+one other internal vertex, or (for r>=4) one spine+full page+a of a second page+b of a third. Basis counts are 12 for r=3 and 2r(r−1)^2 for r>=4.
limitations: r>=3 four-cycle pages only; two-page book and longer page lengths not covered.
